aboutPage.pageTitle: About Actaer: Software Product Company in Serbia
aboutPage.pageDescription: Learn about Actaer, founded in 2015 — a software product company in Novi Pazar, Serbia. We build VantumIQP and FaberPDF and run a consulting practice for AI, software development, and digital modernization.
aboutPage.heroDescription: We're a product company with a consulting practice. We build software people rely on every day — and we help other businesses put AI and modern technology to work.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Actaer is a software product company from Novi Pazar, Serbia. We build VantumIQP, a governed business-intelligence workspace, and FaberPDF, a local-first PDF editor — and we help other companies put AI and modern technology to work through our consulting practice.
story.paragraph2: We set out to change that. Our founding team has experience in enterprise software, startups, and consulting. We know what works, what fails, and why many tech projects do not succeed.
story.paragraph3: As a new firm, we offer fresh views and modern methods — free from old ideas. We partner with businesses of all sizes to build software that works well, grows as needed, and adds true value.
story.paragraph4: Our products, VantumIQP and FaberPDF, embody everything we believe about software: modern, user-friendly, and built for how businesses actually operate today.

values.title: Our Values
values.description: The principles that guide everything we do.

resultsDriven.description: We measure success by the impact we create for our clients, not by hours logged or lines of code written.

clientCentric.title: Client-Centric
clientCentric.description: Your success is our success. We build long-term partnerships based on trust, transparency, and mutual growth.

innovationFocused.title: Innovation-Focused
innovationFocused.description: We stay at the forefront of technology, bringing cutting-edge solutions to solve your most challenging problems.

collaborative.title: Collaborative
collaborative.description: We work as an extension of your team, fostering open communication and shared ownership of outcomes.

mission.title: Our Mission

aiConsultingPage.pageDescription: AI strategy and roadmaps, model selection, agentic automation and team enablement. Practical AI consulting from a company that builds software products.
aiConsultingPage.heroTitle: Put AI to work where it earns its keep
aiConsultingPage.heroDescription: We help companies move from AI curiosity to AI in production — strategy, pilots, automation and the training your teams need to keep it running.
aiConsultingPage.offering1Description: Where AI creates value in your business, what to build vs. buy, and a sequenced plan your board can sign off on.
aiConsultingPage.offering2Description: Model and vendor selection, integration with your existing systems, and evaluation that goes beyond the demo.
aiConsultingPage.offering3Description: Agentic workflows for document processing, reporting and operations — deployed with guardrails, not hype.
aiConsultingPage.offering4Description: Hands-on workshops that leave your engineers and operators able to run and extend what we build.
aiConsultingPage.whyTitle: Advice backed by products we ship
aiConsultingPage.whyDescription: VantumIQP and FaberPDF keep us honest: we deal with data governance, deployment and support every day. That experience — not a methodology binder — is what we bring to your AI initiative.
aiConsultingPage.ctaDescription: Book a working session and leave with next steps, not a sales pitch.

softwareDevelopmentPage.pageDescription: Custom software development by a product company: full-stack engineering, enterprise integrations and real-time platforms, delivered end to end.
softwareDevelopmentPage.heroTitle: Custom software, built like a product
softwareDevelopmentPage.heroDescription: From requirements to running system — engineered by the team that builds VantumIQP and FaberPDF.
softwareDevelopmentPage.offering1Description: Web and desktop applications with modern stacks — TypeScript, React, .NET, and the cloud platform you already use.
softwareDevelopmentPage.offering2Description: Connecting the systems you have — ERP, BI, document flows — instead of replacing them wholesale.
softwareDevelopmentPage.offering3Description: Dashboards, event pipelines and operational tooling that keep up with your business.
softwareDevelopmentPage.offering4Description: Maintenance, monitoring and iteration after launch — we don't ship and vanish.
softwareDevelopmentPage.ctaDescription: Tell us what you need built and we'll scope it together.

digitalModernizationPage.pageTitle: Digital Modernization — Adopt Technology That Sticks
digitalModernizationPage.pageDescription: We teach companies how to modernize: legacy assessment, process digitization and pragmatic technology adoption, guided by engineers who ship products.
digitalModernizationPage.heroDescription: We help organizations move off spreadsheets, paper and legacy systems — step by step, with your team learning as we go.
digitalModernizationPage.offering1Description: An honest map of what you run today, what it costs you, and what to change first.
digitalModernizationPage.offering2Description: Turning manual, paper-driven workflows into digital ones your staff actually adopt.
digitalModernizationPage.offering3Description: Selecting and rolling out the right tools — BI, document management, automation — without shelfware.
digitalModernizationPage.offering4Description: We work alongside your people so the capability stays when the engagement ends.
digitalModernizationPage.ctaDescription: A one-day assessment is often enough to see the first three moves.

vantumiqpPage.pageDescription: VantumIQP is a governed BI workspace built on Apache Superset: dashboards, SQL exploration and decision-ready reports. Request a demo.
vantumiqpPage.heroTitle: Open your data. See the story. Share the answer.
vantumiqpPage.heroDescription: VantumIQP is a business intelligence workspace built on Apache Superset — a calmer path from data questions to shared answers, with governance built in.
vantumiqpPage.feature1Description: Bar to sankey — every visualization your reports need, ready out of the box.
vantumiqpPage.feature2Description: Explore data in SQL without switching tools; every chart stays traceable to its query.
vantumiqpPage.feature3Description: Role-aware dashboards with row-level access and permission management.
vantumiqpPage.feature4Description: Reusable, documented datasets so teams answer questions from the same source of truth.
vantumiqpPage.feature5Description: A clean separation between exploratory analysis and formal, decision-ready reports.
vantumiqpPage.feature6Description: The power of Apache Superset with cleaner UX and guided workflows on top.
vantumiqpPage.audienceTitle: Teams that need governed answers, not another tool to babysit
vantumiqpPage.audienceDescription: Organizations that want dashboards stakeholders actually understand — with the traceability and access control an enterprise expects. Demo access only for now: we start with your use case, not a checkout page.
vantumiqpPage.ctaTitle: See VantumIQP on your own data
vantumiqpPage.ctaDescription: Book a demo and we'll walk through your reporting workflow together.

faberpdfPage.pageDescription: FaberPDF is a modern local-first desktop PDF editor for Windows and Linux. Sign, annotate, edit and validate PDFs without cloud uploads. Free during beta.
faberpdfPage.heroDescription: Signing a document, marking up a page, validating a file or fixing a small text issue should not require a cloud round-trip. FaberPDF keeps PDF work on your desktop.
faberpdfPage.feature1Description: Add signatures to contracts and forms without sending them to a third-party server.
faberpdfPage.feature2Description: Mark up, comment and highlight — review documents at desktop speed.
faberpdfPage.feature3Description: Fix typos and make focused corrections directly in the PDF.
faberpdfPage.feature4Description: Check PDF integrity and standards conformance before you send.
faberpdfPage.feature5Description: Native desktop builds for both platforms.
faberpdfPage.feature6Description: Version 0.1.0 is free to download and try — your feedback shapes the roadmap.
faberpdfPage.privacyTitle: Your documents never leave your machine
faberpdfPage.privacyDescription: Browser-based PDF tools mean uploading contracts, invoices and personal documents to someone else's server. FaberPDF does the work on your desktop, so sensitive files stay exactly where they belong.
faberpdfPage.ctaDescription: Free during beta, for Windows and Linux.
